name: kvastram-commerce-template
description: Reusable full-stack ecommerce template with storefront, admin, and API applications.

scripts.setup: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --prefix backend && npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --prefix storefront && npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --prefix admin
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix storefront run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:run && npm --prefix storefront run test:unit -- --run
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix storefront run build && npm --prefix admin run build

author: sunil kumar saini
